title: Beyond PUE: A Local Impact Audit Framework for Data Center Environmental Accountability
abstract: arXiv:2609.23421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard data center sustainability metrics, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE), and Carbon Usage Effectiveness (CUE), measure a facility's resource use and emissions intensity, normalized to IT energy use, without directly representing local resource scarcity, infrastructure capacity, or social footprint. This gap has become politically consequential. In the first quarter of 2026 alone, local opposition delayed or canceled roughly $130 billion in projects across the United States, driven overwhelmingly by recurring concerns over water use, power demand, infrastructure capacity, and transparency rather than internal efficiency, matching the total for all of 2025 [11]. We propose a five-category local impact audit framework covering efficiency, water stewardship, carbon and renewables, regulatory compliance, and local disclosure. translated_title: 超越PUE：数据中心环境问责的本地影响审计框架
translated_abstract: 标准的数据中心可持续性指标，包括电力使用效率（PUE）、水使用效率（WUE）和碳使用效率（CUE），衡量的是设施的资源使用和排放强度，并以IT能源使用量进行归一化，但并未直接反映当地的资源稀缺性、基础设施容量或社会足迹。这一缺陷已产生重大的政治影响。仅2026年第一季度，美国就有约1300亿美元的项目因当地反对而被推迟或取消，其主要原因是对水资源使用、电力需求、基础设施容量和透明度的反复担忧，而非内部效率问题，这一数字已与2025年全年的总额相当。我们提出了一个涵盖五个类别的本地影响审计框架，包括效率、水资源管理、碳与可再生能源、监管合规以及本地信息披露。该框架旨在用于定期的季度评估和持续改进……
tldr: 该论文指出现有PUE、WUE、CUE等指标无法反映数据中心对本地资源稀缺性、基础设施容量和社会足迹的影响，并提出一个涵盖效率、水资源管理、碳与可再生能源、监管合规和本地披露五个类别的本地影响审计框架，以应对日益增长的社区反对和项目阻力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a five-category local impact audit framework—covering efficiency, water stewardship, carbon and renewables, regulatory compliance, and local disclosure—to address the gap where standard metrics like PUE, WUE, and CUE fail to capture data centers' impacts on local resource scarcity, infrastructure capacity, and social footprint, which have driven $130 billion in project delays and cancellations in early 2026.
